heading: Building Authority may require on-site tests
content:
19.
Building Authority may require on-site tests
(1)
If the Building Authority has any doubt as to the design assumption or load carrying capacity of a foundation, the Building Authority may require tests to be carried out on-site.
(2)
The tests may be carried out on the foundation or on the ground on which the foundation rests—
(a)
by means of imposition of test loads; or
(b)
by means of any other suitable method.
